name: RAJA Cluster, offshore East Kertih, Terengganu
description: Small/marginal field cluster, ~6.1 mmboe 2P; uses Dialog's Tarpon platform for fields in <100 m water; 14-year SFA PSC including 2 years pre-development, ~2 years construction/commissioning and ~10 years production. Dialog also operates Baram Junior Cluster (since 2023) and Mutiara Cluster (from June 2025).
